Amazon just launched the best Alienware gaming PC deal I've seen in months. For Black Friday, you can pick up a brand new Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 gaming PC for $2,799.99 with free shipping. A simillar configuration would cost $1,000 more if you purchased it directly from Dell. Although Amazon labels this as a Black Friday deal, I can say with certainty that it will sell out well before November 27. If it goes out of stock, there's one other RTX 5080 PC deal going on right now.

Alienware Aurora RTX 5080 Gaming PC for $2,800

This Alienware Aurora gaming PC is equipped with an Intel Core Ultra 9 285 CPU, GeForce RTX 5080 16GB GPU, 32GB of DDR5-5600MHz RAM, and a 1TB SSD. The Core Ultra 9 285 is a 24-core processor with a max turbo frequency of 5.6GHz. It was released back in 2025, but it still ranks up there as one of Intel's top performers for gaming, productivity, and AI. It's cooled by a 240mm all-in-one liquid cooling system and the entire rig is powered by a generously sized 1,000W 80Plus Platinum certified power supply.

The GeForce RTX 5080 GPU will run any game in 4K

Performance-wise, the RTX 5080 is no slouch. It's one of the fastest cards on the market, bested only by the $2,000 (retail) RTX 5090 and the discontinued $1,600 (retail) RTX 4090. You'll be able to play latest, most demanding games in 4K resolution at high settings and ray tracing enabled. The DLSS 4.5 update has further optimized multi-frame gen and upscaling so you can push really high framerates even in 4K. More games are supporting this feature, including Doom: The Dark Ages, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, Battlefield 6, Death Stranding 2, and Crimson Desert. Check out our Nvidia GeForce RTX 5080 FE review for our hands-on impressions.
